entries.title: 可合法共同研读的两书数字文本与具体版次核实
entries.required_evidence: 准确的目录、在线文本/扫描及其版本归属、可公开使用范围；现代整理本与历史原文分开
entries.next_action: Exact 六壬金针 physical four-volume TOC was directly inspected from user photos (RESEARCH-0003). P0 remains OPEN for publisher/imprint/authorized digital full text and matching the 269-page online file; do not upload photos, handwriting or unlicensed full text. Begin joint reading from inspected intro pp1-5, then obtain limited legal access to first lesson pp6ff.

entries.title: 两书主题对照与首次共同研习专题
entries.required_evidence: 两本书可核实的目录和章次结构
entries.next_action: Full physical TOC now available. Study can begin with actual introduction pp1–5, with the first structured lesson at vol I p6 ('学习大六壬前必须掌握的基础知识'); ask only for limited necessary passage pages; no repeated full-book photography.

entries.title: 大六壬指南五卷与四卷在线文本编排及版系关系
entries.required_evidence: Version-specific complete tables of contents and source edition or physical witness; no automatic conflation of volume numbers
entries.next_action: Locate and inspect 1790 三得堂 edition pages or other identified witnesses; compare the 2016 five-volume edition and 4-volume online content; do not infer merger solely from chapter names.

entries.title: 《六壬金针》与《大六壬心法指要》的目录高度相似及正文/版本关系
entries.required_evidence: Both works' identified edition pages, copyright/publisher information, parallel passages under permission, publication dates and revision statements. Titles and parallel TOC alone cannot prove identity.
entries.next_action: Compare physical copyright/imprint page when available; check authority/publisher statements and limited corresponding passages; do not merge book identities or text provenance before independent verification.

entries.title: 占断预测能力的验证与适用边界：是否存在事前可测的准确性优势
entries.required_evidence: Specify measurable prediction tasks, fixed rule versions, pre-registered conditions and predictions, independently checked outcomes, baseline comparison, complete success/failure/uncertain counts and protection of private case data. No conclusion of 100% accuracy without extraordinary repeatable evidence.
entries.next_action: At appropriate future chapters, design ethically safe, anonymized pre-registered case protocol separating calculable chart rules, internally consistent interpretation, and empirical forecast performance. Keep unresolved without blocking full-book study.

entries.title: 《六壬金针》导论“理气法则”与《壬归》理气类象说及北海闲人课传气势的明确对应关系
entries.required_evidence: 版本绑定的《六壬金针》后续段落/具体断课例、《壬归》理气类象说原页及版本、北海闲人其他作品具体定义；对理、五气、十二气、课传气势、取类优先级逐一绑定出处；条件、例外、反例及断课一致性测试
entries.next_action: Carry as research side-question without blocking cover-to-cover study. Do not equate modern authors' terms with a single proven historical algorithm. When reading corresponding passages, map exact definitions; preserve differences and seek pre-declared conflict-resolution rules.

entries.title: 《六壬金针》实体本p9阴干无刃与同题在线卷二阴干有刃、土胎额外子位的规则边界
entries.required_evidence: 以用户实体书卷二p101及后续实际页照片为准核“阴干羊刃”和长生/胎位完整文字；明确网络文本的底本、印次和转录准确性。分别复核土胎午与子兼用的含义、干禄与五行旺的模型边界，寻找同书对应课例并标注所采用规则版本。
entries.next_action: Continue sequential book reading. When physical Jinzhen volume II p101 section 8 is reached, compare original print with publicly hosted online chapter did=820; do not predeclare contradiction or silently resolve yin-blade variants. Search references to 土胎子 after p9 without stalling chapter order.
